d: Five people were killed and one was injured in a shooting at Hotel Bilas Inn in the Bora Service area of Guwahati, Assam, on the night of October 26. The deceased include hotel owner Helena Bharali, her brother, her son, her daughter-in-law, and the family’s driver. According to the police, a property dispute linked to the hotel’s lease agreement may have triggered the incident. The accused, identified as Ghanakanta Gogoi, was arrested within an hour of the shooting. Police have also seized the licensed .32-bore pistol allegedly used in the crime.
